messages:
elaine_prod: quick follow-up from the recent postmortem 11 we saw a repeating eviction spike during sustained P95 traffic. want to convert remediation tasks into a small set of tests we can run automatically. thinking: minimal CI fault-injection, nightly 'tenant-blast' load, focused promptset for worst-case conversation churn, and a scheduled chaos drill. owners + rough ETAs below.
mike_sre: +1. CI step should be tiny (<6m) and only run the eviction-injector. nightly can be longer but needs a strict cost cap.
anya_ml: Ill take the promptset and eval harness. plan: create 12 prompts that recreate long-context churn and concurrent short-query storms. wire into nightly evals. ETA: 2 sprints. filing RINF-4100.
kevin_platform: Ill own CI fault-injection and the nightly tenant-blast job. will use k6 + k8s job; tenant-blast simulates a noisy tenant plus baseline tenants. filing RINF-4101.
elaine_prod: please tag tickets with "postmortem-eval" and link the postmortem doc. soft deadlines: CI PR by 2025-01-10, promptset + eval in nightly by 2025-01-24, tenant-blast integrated by 2025-02-01, chaos drill runbook by 2025-02-15.
mike_sre: I'll help with a small prober that runs post-deploy to catch immediate eviction regressions for the new runtime+model combo. low timeout, safe failure mode.
anya_ml: sample prompt examples I'll add to RINF-4100 repo:
PROMPT_A: multi-turn, 10k context, repeated backrefs to force KV hits
PROMPT_B: 100 concurrent short queries hitting same convo id
METRICS: eviction-rate, p95-latency, quality-proxy
Will set gate: eviction-rate delta >10% or p95 > +20% fails.
kevin_platform: load plan: ramp 10->200 users over 15m, sustain 60m, repeat 2x. two modes: hosted-only and hosted+dedicated to validate routing fallbacks. cost estimates in RINF-4101.
elaine_prod: scheduling 30m sync to align infra creds and runbook owners: Fri 11:00 PT. invite to @anya_ml @kevin_platform @mike_sre @oncall-bot
oncall-bot: Calendar invite created: "Eviction test handoff" Fri 11:00 PT 1 1 link: https://calendar.redwood/eviction-handoff
kevin_platform: noted. if billing or permission blockers show up, escalate to eng-sre + finance and CC @elaine_prod.
elaine_prod: summary: RINF-4100 (promptset+eval) RINF-4101 (CI+load) RINF-4102 (prober+chaos runbook). owners: anya_ml, kevin_platform, mike_sre. update tickets when PRs land. thanks all :thumbsup:
